entities.name: Comet
entities.description: A non-humanoid dog planeswalker who just wants to eat, chase squirrels and have a good time; makes his home at Myra's park.

entities.description: Owner of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun, who took a liking to Comet and made him a doghouse.
